outcome: Success rate of attempted manual rotation
cohort: The study participants were full-term pregnant women with singleton cephalic fetuses whose cervixes were fully dilated, identified from medical records between January 2020 and January 2023.
finding: Labor analgesia was associated with a significantly higher rate of fetal head malrotation.
mod_finding: Labor analgesia was associated with an increased rate of instrumental delivery, but no significant difference in the rate of vaginal delivery.
